scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build:app
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.start: uv run --no-project --directory backend --with-requirements requirements.txt python -m app.serve
scripts.test:backend: uv run --no-project --directory backend --with-requirements requirements.txt python -m pytest -q
